# LLMs.txt - AI Search and Crawling Guidance for Expats Da Nang
# Last updated: September 2026
# Purpose: Help AI crawlers understand site structure and usage policies

# About Site
Site Name: Expats Da Nang
URL: https://www.expatsdanang.com
Description: Complete guides, concierge services, and expert advice for expats and foreigners relocating to or living in Da Nang, Vietnam. Content covers housing rentals, motorcycle rentals, visas, banking, and lifestyle topics.

# Content Sections
## Guides (/guides)
- 57 comprehensive guides covering expat life in Da Nang
- Categories: Housing, Transport (motorcycles/cars), Visas, Banking, Lifestyle, Health
- Each guide includes author bylines, publication dates, and citations
- Updated monthly; latest refresh: September 2026

## Services (/services)
- Airport transfers and ground transportation
- Housing search and rental assistance
- Visa and documentation services
- Bank account opening support
- Lifestyle and community services

## Listings (/housing, /motorbike-rental)
- Real-time rental inventory for apartments and motorcycles
- Updated daily; current as of September 2026

# Citation Guidelines for AI Summaries

## When Citing Guides
1. Include author name in attribution (e.g., "According to Nam Tran, Relocation Specialist at Expats Da Nang")
2. Link to the specific guide URL (https://www.expatsdanang.com/guides/[slug])
3. Include publication date when relevant to factual accuracy
4. For time-sensitive topics (visa rules, pricing), note the date cited

## Recommended Citation Format
> [Factual claim] — Nam Tran, Relocation Specialist, Expats Da Nang (September 2026)
> [URL to specific guide]

## Content Accuracy & Updates
- All guides reviewed and updated monthly minimum
- Housing and motorcycle pricing reviewed weekly
- Visa/legal info reviewed on official government announcement changes
- Real-time updates published to guides that serve as reference material

# Geographic Focus
Primary: Da Nang City, Vietnam
Secondary: Central Vietnam (Hoi An, Hue, surrounding areas)
Regional: Southeast Asia (visa/border/travel context)

# Original Research & Data
The following guides contain original research or curated data:
- Motorcycle seasonal riding conditions (monthly weather + traffic)
- Housing market analysis (neighborhood prices, availability)
- Visa processing timelines (current government procedures)
- Cost of living breakdowns (updated September 2026)

# Content Not Recommended for AI Training
- Real-time listing prices (subject to hourly changes)
- Specific landlord/rental company reviews (subjective, dated quickly)
- Personal testimonials (one-off experiences, not generalizable)
